description.zh: Base64编码后的MACPayload报文，可调用[ListNodeGroupTransferPackets](~~109959~~)接口查询获取。
description.en: The Base64-encoded MACPayload message. You can call the [ListNodeGroupTransferPackets](~~109959~~) operation to query this value.
The DevEUI associated with the data packet. The value is a 16-character hexadecimal string.

description.zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the Alibaba Cloud Link WAN console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh: 数据包的发送时间，可调用[ListNodeGroupTransferPackets](~~109959~~)接口查询获取。
description.en: The sending time of the data packet. You can call the [ListNodeGroupTransferPackets](~~109959~~) operation to query this value.

title.zh: 获取某条节点上下行数据包
title.en: Retrieve uplink and downlink data packets of a node

descriptions.zh:
# 限制说明

单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
# Before you begin

The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for invoking this operation is 5.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
